description.p: Bivouac turns cybersecurity competition material into something you can practise with every day, until the competition.

ul.li: Study packs, one per competition: import a Cybearly "Campo base" manual, open a pack file, or start an empty pack and write your own cards
Chapter recaps, key-concept tables and self-check questions
Spaced-repetition flashcards that make sure every card comes back before the competition day, and a multiple-choice drill
A searchable glossary and command cheatsheet, and the manual itself, opened at the right page

description.p: First release: study packs, chapter recaps, spaced-repetition flashcards, multiple-choice drill, glossary, cheatsheet and the manual in a built-in reader.
